text:
Which statement is not correct?
A
When a base reacts with an ammonium salt, ammonia is given off.
B
When an acid reacts with a base, neutralisation takes place.
C
When an acid reacts with a carbonate, carbon dioxide is given off.
D
When the acidity of a solution increases, the pH increases.

options.label: A
options.text: When a base reacts with an ammonium salt, ammonia is given off.

options.label: B
options.text: When an acid reacts with a base, neutralisation takes place.

options.label: C
options.text: When an acid reacts with a carbonate, carbon dioxide is given off.

options.label: D
options.text: When the acidity of a solution increases, the pH increases.
